# AI Coding Guide

- **Stack + layout**: Current app is a Tauri 2 desktop build (Rust backend + vanilla TypeScript/DOM front-end). README and legacy GitHub Actions still describe an old Python/pywebview app—follow the TypeScript/Rust sources instead.
- **Frontend entry**: [ui/src/main.ts](../ui/src/main.ts) wires all modules, owns the in-memory `currentLexicon`, `currentFilePath`, and `isModified` flags, and invokes backend commands (`open_file`, `parse_xml_command`, `build_xml_command`, `save_file_command`, `diff`). Updates must preserve the array shape of `lexicon.entry` and call `setIsModified(true)`/`invoke("set_modified")` when mutating.
- **Table rendering**: [ui/src/LexiconTable.ts](../ui/src/LexiconTable.ts) renders the entry grid, sortable by column. Custom lexical ordering comes from header `sort-order` (parsed as a whitespace/comma-delimited token list). Display options toggle columns and expanded multi-value rows via [ui/src/DisplayOptions.ts](../ui/src/DisplayOptions.ts).
- **Entry editing**: [ui/src/EntryEditor.ts](../ui/src/EntryEditor.ts) mutates the selected entry in place, keeping `$` attrs for IDs/timestamps and arrays for fields. Auto-complete datalists are built from existing lexicon values. Custom fields are derived from header `custom-fields.field-spec` (level `entry` or `sense`). `markChanged()` bumps `dateModified` and triggers `onChange` → table re-render.
- **Lexicon configuration**: [ui/src/ConfigDialog.ts](../ui/src/ConfigDialog.ts) edits header metadata and manages custom fields; it normalizes field names to `[A-Za-z0-9_]+`. When adding new header fields, remember the header may be an array or object.
- **Diff UI + restore**: [ui/src/DiffViewer.ts](../ui/src/DiffViewer.ts) builds a diff payload (left/right sources: working object, disk path, or git `HEAD`) and field filters. Default diff ignores timestamps unless `dateModified` is explicitly included. Restore/delete actions mutate the in-memory lexicon only; callers must still call `onChange` to refresh UI/state.
- **XML model + serialization**: Backend parsing/building lives in [src-tauri/src/xml_utils.rs](../src-tauri/src/xml_utils.rs). Attributes are stored under `$`, text under `_`, and many tags are forced into arrays (`FORCED_LISTS`). `build_xml` enforces child ordering (e.g., lexicon → header → entry; sense → grammatical-category → gloss → definition). Provide a single-root object like `{ "lexicon": { ... } }` to serialize.
- **Diff backend**: [src-tauri/src/diff_utils.rs](../src-tauri/src/diff_utils.rs) canonicalizes lexicons before diffing (sorts entries by `id`, drops `dateModified` if `ignore_timestamps`, flattens field arrays to first value, sorts variants/senses). Source types: `object` (expects `lexicon`), `disk` (re-parse XML), `git` (reads `rev:path` relative to repo root).
- **Backend commands**: Defined in [src-tauri/src/main.rs](../src-tauri/src/main.rs): `open_file`/`save_file_dialog_command` use `rfd` dialogs; `parse_xml_command`, `build_xml_command`, `save_file_command`, `set_modified`, `diff`, `get_lexicon_from_source`. Front-end invokes via `@tauri-apps/api` `invoke`.
- **Data shape expectations**: `lexicon.entry` is always an array; each entry stores fields as arrays, `$` attrs (id/dateCreated/dateModified), and `sense` arrays with `$` id/order plus `grammatical-category`/`gloss` arrays. When creating entries/senses/variants, wrap values in arrays to avoid serializer surprises.
- **Sorting semantics**: Table sort defaults to lexical-unit ascending; clicking headers toggles direction. Custom lexical order uses the header token list to build a precedence map; ensure tokens cover expected digraphs if you modify sorting logic.
- **UI wiring**: HTML is static in [ui/index.html](../ui/index.html) and CSS in [ui/src/assets/styles.css](../ui/src/assets/styles.css) plus [ui/src/assets/diff-styles.css](../ui/src/assets/diff-styles.css). Modules query by `id`, so keep IDs stable when adjusting markup.
- **Dev/build workflow**: Node side uses Vite; root configured to `ui` in [vite.config.ts](../vite.config.ts). Commands: `npm install`; `npm run dev` for front-end only; `npm run tauri dev` to run the full app; `npm run build` to type-check and build UI to `dist`; `npm run tauri build` to package. Rust tests exist in [src-tauri/src/xml_utils.rs](../src-tauri/src/xml_utils.rs) (`cargo test -p app`).
- **Gotchas**: Legacy Python artifacts (README, workflow) are stale; prefer Tauri paths. Keep apply_patch edits ASCII-only. Preserve forced array fields and attribute/text conventions; forgetting arrays or `$` keys will break serialization and diffing.

If anything here is unclear or missing, tell me what to expand or correct.
